title: Sharp gradient estimates for a class of singular/degenerate fully nonlinear elliptic equations with oblique boundary conditions and Hamiltonian terms
summary: This paper focus on a class of singular or degenerate fully nonlinear elliptic equations with Hamiltonian terms under oblique boundary conditions on $C^{1}$ domains. Under quite general conditions on the singularity/degeneracy of the model, we establish the sharp $C^{1,α}$ regularity up to the boundary within a unified framework.
